blocks.html: In support of the government’s pediatric vaccination roll-out, Robinsons Malls welcomes kids from 5 to 11 years old in its vaccination sites nationwide. To kick off the joint program, a ceremonial Pediatric Vaccination Event was scheduled on its pilot run last February 7 at Robinsons Town Mall Malabon led by Lone District Representative of Malabon City Hon. Josephine “Jaye”Lacson-Noel.

“As we want our kids to have a conducive place for their first jab, Robinsons Malls has prepared special treats, fun activities and other surprises for them”, says Jas Lucio, Regional Operations Manager of Robinsons Malls.

Robinsons Malls has also partnered with Tom's World to ensure a child-friendly vaccination area. Kids will get to mingle with their favorite mascots, enjoy fun games, and get exciting treats from other partner tenants.

Upcoming pediatric vaccination sites will be in Robinsons Place La Pinas from February 8 onwards; Robinsons Magnolia on February 15-20; Robinsons Novaliches on February 15-17; Robinsons Galleria Ortigas on February 18-20; Robinsons Place Naga until February 28; and Robinsons Place Gen Tri on February 10-11. Follow Robinsons Malls official in Facebook and IG for more updates on venues and schedules.
